libs.note: BH-3886: the knobs of bin/main-red-detector.sh's merge-queue hooks. The detector resolves both once per tick with lib_env_apply main-red-detector in a subshell with the env names unset (settings row lib.main-red-detector.<env lowercased>, then env, then the default; a value that is not a whole number is the default, never off), exports them as MR_QUEUE_ATTR and MR_QUEUE_SELF_DISPATCH_MIN, and logs one `queue knobs` line. The hooks that consume them live in bin/lib/main-red-queue-attr.sh and bin/lib/main-red-queue-dispatch.sh. tests/main-red-queue-hooks.bh-3886-test.sh drives it.

knobs.note: The self-dispatch interval, in minutes, of a reason=queue freeze. The rule that reads it is bin/lib/main-red-queue-dispatch.sh's (mrqd_self_dispatch); this script only resolves it and exports it as MR_QUEUE_SELF_DISPATCH_MIN. 0 = off.

Attribution of red merge-queue batches: 1 = ask bin/lib/main-red-queue-attr.sh's mrqa_attr about each counted batch and leave out the ones its own PR broke; 0 = off, every independent red batch counts as before. Exported as MR_QUEUE_ATTR.
